messages:
sara_sales: Hey team — AcmeEdge (partner) wants a shared POC where we host a Dedicated pool tied into their VPC. They want joint architecture, SSO, HSM/KMS options, and a pricing sketch for bursty traffic. Can we do a quick handoff & call? cc @ana_partner

ana_partner: Thanks Sara. They want data to remain in their VPC, HSM for keys, and regional traffic shaping (EU primary). Latency matters — assistant use-case, median ctx len ~512, spikes up to 2048 tokens. Also they're asking about telemetry export and per-tenant logs.

sam_se: I can take lead on tech presales. Quick questions: expected sustained QPS vs burst QPS? what's acceptable p90 latency? We should propose two configs: 1) dev sandbox (1 x small GPU pool + burst buffer) and 2) pilot (3-4 GPUs, dedicated KV caching). Action items: topology diagram, SSO flow (SAML/OIDC), network egress plan, load test script, and a security questionnaire response.

sara_sales: p90 target they mentioned is <150ms for single-turn chat in EU region. Burst up to ~200 concurrent users hitting LLM for the first month.

sam_se: ok. I'll sketch an initial architecture: Redwood Dedicated in their VPC peered to partner infra, frontend routes to a regional gateway, tenant-level routing to dedicated pool, and fallback to hosted model if capacity exhausted. Will include canary policy.

sam_se: sample load test snippet (simple k6 curl flow):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-large-v1","input":"Summarize this user message","max_tokens":256}'
```

lee_eng: Pricing notes: for co-sell/shared POC we can offer a pilot bundle — base monthly reserve + burst credits. Suggest: 50% upfront commit for baseline (3 months), burst billed at usage with a partner discount (15-25%) for first 3 months. Also note dedicated provisioning lead time ~10 business days for reserved GPUs; if they need faster, we can offer hosted fallback.

lee_eng: Telemetry: we can export aggregated token metrics and per-tenant latency traces to their telemetry exporter (no raw PII). We'll provide a telemetry schema and sampling guidance.

ana_partner: Security Qs: they sent a short security questionnaire (SaaS vendor checklist) and asked about SOC2 control mappings and where keys live. Can we confirm HSM option + customer-managed KMS?

sam_se: Yes — we support CMK via KMS/HSM for Private deployments. I'll pull our latest SOC2 answers and attach. Eng-security should review the questionnaire. @lee_eng can you queue security for a fast review?

lee_eng: I'll ping eng-security and attach the SOC2 pack. Also will draft the network egress diagram and a simple tenancy diagram for the partner.

sara_sales: Plan: 1) Call to align architecture & SLAs tomorrow 10:00am PT (propose) 2) Sam to produce load script and basic topology by EOD 3) Lee to draft pricing sketch + security packet 4) Ana to confirm partner availability and VPC details. :calendar:

sam_se: ack — I'll have the load harness and a short runbook for canary rollouts.

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: "AcmeEdge — shared POC kickoff" scheduled 2026-03-23 10:00 PT. Invite: sara_sales, sam_se, lee_eng, ana_partner. :pushpin:

sara_sales: Great — thanks everyone. I'll turn this into a short Runbook and share before the call. :thumbsup:
